table.retrieve:
SELECT 
		 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
		 date  = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), dbo.saleledger.BillingDate, 101) AS DATETIME),
		 Customer = Accounts.Name,
		 Address1 = Customer.Address1,
		 itemname = item.name, 
		 manufacurer = (dbo.manufacturer.name), 
		 looseqty = Sum (dbo.saledetail.looseqty), 
		 price = max(dbo.saledetail.saleprice), 
		 RowID = Max(dbo.saledetail.RowId),
 		 cumulativesum = round(0.00,2), 
 		 cumulativesumfoot = round(0.00,2)
FROM 	 dbo.saleledger, 
		 dbo.saledetail, 
		 dbo.item, 
		 dbo.Customer,
		 dbo.Accounts,
		 dbo.Manufacturer 
WHERE  dbo.saleledger.BillingDate >= :ad_StartDate AND
		 dbo.saleledger.BillingDate <= :ad_EndDate  AND 
		 dbo.saleledger.custcode IN ( :al_custcode ) AND
		 dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) AND
		 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode AND
		 dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode AND
		 dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode AND
		 dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode AND
		 dbo.Item.manfcode = dbo.manufacturer.manfcode
Group by 
		Accounts.Name,
		Customer.Address1,
		CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), dbo.saleledger.BillingDate, 101) AS DATETIME),
		dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
		dbo.saledetail.icode,
		dbo.item.name,
		dbo.manufacturer.name
table.sort: customer A, date A, saleinvcode A, rowid A
